commit: 988d141892711b805f608a178bc940f6e9bb4323

Classic scripts under js/ plus artwork.png and sounds/shoot.mp3.

vendor/main.js is patched:
  - artwork and shot URLs come from window.AAS (data: URLs from assets.js)
  - resize updates the mouse scale instead of restarting the round
  - the playfield is filled #ececec (clearRect on a dark page hid the black player)
  - window.AASShowPad() reveals the shell pad in boot.js (left stick, right-side
    aim, FIRE under the thumb). GuiControls.js still ships, unused.
  - AAS.onGeneration / AAS.onGameover so the shell can save a best
  - AAS.startPlay / retry / goTitle / applyPad for the shell and the unit test

The neuroevolution loop, bots, and genetics are unchanged.
aux.js (service worker) is not shipped.
